name: Four Seasons Resort Punta Mita
insider_take: This oceanfront paradise sits on a dramatic peninsula where the Pacific meets the Sierra Madre mountains, offering unparalleled luxury on Mexico's stunning Riviera Nayarit.
whats_special: Four Seasons Resort Punta Mita boasts two championship Jack Nicklaus golf courses, including the famous "Tail of the Whale" - the world's only natural island green accessible by amphibious cart. The resort features exclusive beach clubs on both Bahía de Banderas and the Pacific Ocean, plus Mexico's first Four Seasons spa temazcal experience.
pro_tip: Book tee times for Hole 3B "Tail of the Whale" during low tide for the most dramatic ocean views, and time your spa temazcal ceremony for sunset to maximize the spiritual cleansing experience.
dont_miss: The nearby Islas Marietas National Park for snorkeling at the famous Hidden Beach (Playa del Amor), and whale watching from December to March when humpback whales migrate through Banderas Bay. The charming colonial town of Sayulita is just 20 minutes away for authentic Mexican culture and world-class surfing.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with pristine beaches and dramatic Pacific coastline views
Two championship Jack Nicklaus golf courses including the famous Tail of the Whale hole
Exceptional dining experiences with multiple restaurants featuring fresh local seafood and international cuisine
World-class spa and wellness facilities with traditional Mexican healing treatments
Outstanding Four Seasons service with personalized attention and luxury amenities
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive resort positioning
Remote Punta Mita location requires planned transportation for off-resort exploration
